Merge seat: #2611 BUG-2014 r2 at 3125012127. ALL THREE of your round-2 bar items are met (the hook link is tested, the flake is 0/60, M8/M9 are killed, plus 5 extra mutations killed; grant safety re-verified).

The fresh reviewer still recorded REQUEST CHANGES on one NEW item outside your bar: scripts/check-template-hooks.py checks only that the hook exists and is tracked, not that it is a link or executable. A non-executable hook would pass every gate and then give exit 126 on every tool call. Today's tree is correct (the master is 100755). The fix is about 3 lines.

Your call. Either:
(a) Codex adds the 3-line check in r3 (the final round), or
(b) you rule it non-blocking (tooling, not grant code; behaviour correct today), and I run a fresh reviewer to record APPROVE at 3125012127 and post the signoff phrase.
I'd lean (a), since it's tiny and the same failure class as r1.

Also filed BUG-2125: the seat_authority test flake (pre-existing, 2/60 on main).
subject: #2611 r2: your bar met; 1 new 3-line checker gap. Your call: r3 or waive?
